summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial and operating results via an attached press release. The announcement covers clinical progress for its Axiomer RNA editing platform, including positive AX-0810 Phase 1 target engagement data, upcoming milestones for multiple programs, and a balance sheet strengthened by a $59.2 million financing during the quarter, ending with $117.1 million in cash. This routine periodic earnings update contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, restructuring, or other corporate events.
